  • Constructor Details

    • Player

      public Player()
      No args constructor Minimum balance a player starts a game with if they do not choose to use money they have won before. Used in testing the Player class and in AiPlayer to set the main fields.

    • Player

      public Player(String name, int balance, String id, int blindSize) throws IOException
      Constructor called for testing other classes that use player objects
      Parameters:
      name - : Player's name, either users name from database or AiPlayer name.
      balance - : Players starting balance
      id - : Players unique identifier used to match hand evaluation winner to a player object
      blindSize - : blindSize represents the smallest bet a player can make
      Throws:
      IOException

    • getActiveBet

      public Integer getActiveBet()
      Returns the amount this player has declared they will bet this turn, or null if no bet has been set yet.
      Returns:
      the active bet as an Integer, or null

    • setActiveBet

      public void setActiveBet(Integer activeBet)
      Sets the amount this player will bet this turn. The value is rounded to the nearest multiple of 5 unless the player is going all-in, in which case it is forced to the player's full balance.
      Parameters:
      activeBet - the desired bet amount, or null to clear the bet

    • roundReset

      public void roundReset()
      Resets this player's state at the start of a new round. Clears the hand, sets action to UNDECIDED, clears the round investment, and turns off the active-turn flag. Also fires a "roundReset" property change event.

    • win

      public void win(int potSize)
      Awards the player the chips they have won from a pot.
      Parameters:
      potSize - the total number of chips won (the pot's share for this player)

    • placeBet

      public int placeBet(int betSize, Pot pot)
      Places a bet of the given size from this player's balance into the specified pot. If the bet equals the player's entire balance it automatically triggers an all-in.
      Parameters:
      betSize - the number of chips to bet; must be > 0 (or 0 only for CALL actions)
      pot - the Pot the chips are placed into
      Returns:
      the actual number of chips placed (maybe capped at balance for all-in)
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if betSize is negative or exceeds balance without an ALLIN action

    • payBlind

      public int payBlind(int blindSize, Pot pot)
      Pays the blind obligation for this player based on their current role. Does nothing if the player is PLAYER or DEALER.
      Parameters:
      blindSize - the base blind size from the game configuration
      pot - the Pot the blind chips are placed into
      Returns:
      the number of chips actually paid as the blind

    • allIn

      public void allIn()
      Commits all remaining chips as an all-in bet. Subtracts the full balance but does not route the chips into a pot directly; pot assignment occurs via placeBet(int, com.example.projectpoker.model.game.Pot) during the betting phase.

    • forfeitGame

      public void forfeitGame()
      Marks the player as having forfeited the game. Only takes effect if the player has already folded; changes the action from FOLD to FORFEIT.

    • play

      public void play(ArrayList<Pot> pots)
      Processes this player's chosen action against the given list of active pots. Converts a RAISE that does not exceed the current call amount into the appropriate CALL or CHECK action, and validates that bet actions carry a positive active bet.
      Parameters:
      pots - the current list of Pot objects so the required call amount can be computed via PotUtil.getToCall(java.util.ArrayList<com.example.projectpoker.model.game.Pot>, com.example.projectpoker.model.game.Player)
